class.name: GameplayTagManager
class.description: The GameplayTagManager handles the registration and retrieval of [GameplayTag]s. It maintains the hierarchical relationship between tags (e.g., "Status.Damage" is a parent of "Status.Damage.Fire"). Access the singleton via [method get_singleton] or the static methods exposed in the implementation.

method.name: get_tag
method.description: Retrieves a registered GameplayTag by its name. Returns an empty/invalid tag if not found.

method.name: get_tag_name
method.description: Returns the name of the tag associated with the given ID.

method.name: register_tag
method.description: Registers a new GameplayTag with the given name. If the tag already exists, returns the existing one. Handles hierarchical naming (dot-separated) automatically.
